URGENT UPPER ENDOSCOPY NOTE

Endoscopist: Synthetic Endoscopist, MD (fictional)
Procedure: Esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD)
Procedure details
The gastroscope was passed through the mouth under direct vision. At 33 cm a large piece of meat filled the lumen. The meat bolus was removed with a Roth net and was not pushed into the stomach. The stomach and duodenum were normal. The bolus was discarded and was not sent to pathology.
